messages:
Helen (People Ops): Arjun just pinged that his passport renewal got pushed. Start date next Tue. We need I-9 verification within 3 business days. Options?
Noor (Hiring Manager): Can we keep the start? Team can do remote onboarding.
Arjun (New Hire): Hi all  yes remote works. I can meet a local notary in Warsaw or use an authorized agent. Also my home connection is unreliable; would like a company laptop for day 1.
Helen (People Ops): Notary or I-9 partner both acceptable. We'll cover vendor fee. Please upload passport scan + renewal receipt to secure intake link.
verifications-bot: @Arjun - secure upload: https://redwood-internal/onboard-upload (expires 72h).
Arjun (New Hire): Uploaded passport scan and renewal confirmation. Notary: "Notariusz Centrum, Warszawa".
Marek (IT): We can ship a loaner (MacBook) via DHL express. Need shipping address and confirm customs paperwork ok. Typical ETA 3 business days to PL if express.
Arjun (New Hire): Shipping: ul. Marszałkowska 10/5, 00-590 Warszawa. DHL express fine. Customs: I can provide ID on pickup.
Helen (People Ops): Payroll & benefits note: benefits portal opens first paid day; payroll will send Polish tax/residency guidance. We'll record benefits walkthrough for timezones.
Noor (Hiring Manager): I'll approve remote day 1. Team will do virtual lunch + intro.
Marek (IT): Ticket IT-7250 created for loaner. Marked express and "new hire first day". Okta invite to be sent 24h prior.
Helen (People Ops): Action list: 1) Arjun: complete notary/agent verification and keep receipt. 2) Marek: ship IT-7250 loaner. 3) Payroll: push Poland tax forms on day 1. 4) Noor: confirm remote-first day. Escalate to me if any step misses the 3-day I-9 window. :white_check_mark:
Arjun (New Hire): Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick help. Looking forward to starting.
